full_prompt:
Draw exactly ONE Small Seal glyph U+3D065.
The supplied chart shows FOUR historical views of the SAME ONE Small Seal character, ordered THX, CCZ, QJZ, DYC. Compare EVERY available witness equally; any slot marked unavailable provides no evidence. Create ONE newly drawn, coherent contemporary sans-serif/Gothic glyph informed by all witnesses, selecting ONE coherent attested construction where variants differ. Never combine incompatible components or replace this with modern Chinese. Trace the real continuous writing-stroke courses using smooth rounded curves and appropriate straight segments; preserve all meaningful branches, legs, bars, counters, crossings, attachments and detachments. Each intentional stroke has the SAME CONSTANT width, approximately 3% of the full canvas, with rounded caps and joins. No brush taper, thick/thin pressure, serifs, texture, ink blobs, doubled outlines or ornamental seal effects. Output exactly ONE complete glyph, black on transparent alpha, centered within the central70% of a square canvas with generous clear margins. No reference copies, four-character layout, labels, text, frames, grid, backdrop or shadows.
STRUCTURAL READING AID:
1. THX, CCZ, QJZ available; DYC blank. Left ritual radical has shorter detached upper bar, longer lower bar with attached center descender, plus two separate side descenders.
2. Right main stroke begins as a tall LEFT vertical. Near upper-third it joins a three-way fork: diagonal rises RIGHT to a second upright vertical, and from that junction a short diagonal arm ends freely to LOWER RIGHT. The second upright extends well above the diagonal junction; main left vertical also continues above the junction.
3. Below fork, a long horizontal branch projects RIGHT from the main left vertical. Its right reach is approximately the same as or a little beyond the upper fork right arm endpoint. There is exactly ONE such middle horizontal.
4. Main left vertical continues down below that middle bar and makes a smooth reverse-S-like turn: curve to RIGHT into a long descending lower tail ending freely near bottom-right, as in coherent THX/CCZ form. Do not add a bottom baseline or extra foot.
5. Right structure has NO closed counter, TWO separated tall upper tips, fork free right arm, middle free horizontal tip and ONE lower free tail; preserve all these branches and rounded turns.
Use all three witnesses to understand identity, and retain a coherent descending lower-tail form attested in THX/CCZ rather than mixing it with QJZ's horizontal lower terminal. Keep the two tall tips, the diagonal fork and its free right arm, middle horizontal, smooth lower tail.
